'''Amanda Wolfe''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[June 2001 Ottawa tournament]] on 3 June 2001 with Walker Garrison, according to Thomas Dowling's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2405">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-03-ottawa-canada-03-06-01d2405/ ottawa-canada-03-06-01], DeckTech (Thomas "COTEB" Dowling, 3 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-03-ottawa-canada-03-06-01d2405/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
